dataList.content:
Alright, that's good enough.
好，到此为止。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Training Grounds
大观园 演武场

dataList.content:
Bloody hell, lad. That was much closer than I thought!
哎呀。你这小不点还真有两下子啊？就差一点真是可惜了。

... Huff... huff... G-good match.
……哈……哈……辛、辛苦了。

... Jeez, don't most people usually lose steam the longer a fight gets? What the heck was that at the end...?
……正常人不都应该越打越没劲吗？最后那会到底是怎么回事……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
The two of them clashed with everything they learned, and with all they learned up until the lessons began...
双方将迄今为止所学，连同以前练就的本领一并用在这次交锋上。

I thought for sure that Jia Xichun would come out on top without breaking a sweat, given that Sinclair wasn't using an Identity and the tough training Jia Xichun had as a Family Hierarch candidate, but...
在不使用人格卡的情况下，我原以为作为家主候选人培养的贾惜春会毫不费力地获胜……

... perhaps thanks to the Night Drifter's teachings, or thanks to that mark on his forehead...
也许是因为醉手夜客的教导，抑或是因为他额头上的那个印记。

... I saw a glimpse of Sinclair I'd only seen in a select few Mirror Worlds.
那种只有在透过玻璃窗窥见的镜像世界里才能偶尔看到的奇异身影，我竟然从辛克莱身上看出了一点点。

<You alright, Sinclair...?>
<没事吧，辛克莱……？>

Hm? Uh... yeah, it's not like we were going at it with real weapons. And the fight ended before it got any further, thankfully, so I'm not hurt or anything.
诶？呃……毕竟也不是真的武器，而且中途还停下来了，所以我没有受伤。

I'm feeling a bit of fever on my forehead, though...
就是感觉额头好像有点发烫……

It didn't seem like Sinclair noticed the single, yet clear, red line that appeared on his forehead.
看来，辛克莱似乎并没有注意到额头上清晰浮现的那一划红色。

It's not like anything bad happened when that mark manifested back in La Manchaland, but...
虽然在拉·曼却领短暂出现的时候也没发生什么事……

... considering that Demian and Rim were the only other people who'd ever shown similar marks, I couldn't help but worry a little.
但一想到拥有相似印记的德米安和林，我就不禁有点担心。

... Hey, you ever run away from home before?
……你，有离家出走过吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Uh... where's this coming from?
诶……为什么突然这么问？

Going by the way you're acting, it's clear to me that you're a homebody, but...
从你的行为举止来看，显然是从小就习惯了在富裕的家庭中长大……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... there's something behind your eyes that tells me that your life hasn't all been sunshine and rainbows.
但你的眼神却又并不像那种一直无忧无虑地长大的人。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Hm... I wouldn't call it 'running away from home'... it's more like I left home.
嗯……比起离家出走……更准确来说应该只是离开家吧。

... Because I didn't have a choice.
……因为我别无选择，只能离开家了。

How did that feel?
那是什么感觉？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... Like I was melting away into nothing. I suddenly had to face the whole terrible world all on my own, and that was so overwhelming that—well, I'm sure you can't quite commiserate. You've been on top of your game your whole life, after all.
……就像我要无形地融化一样。我不得不突然独自面对的世界，是多么庞大，多么可怕……啊，对惜春小姐来说可能很难理解吧，毕竟你一直都很出类拔萃。

... I did leave Daguanyuan by my own volition, but...
……虽然我是自愿走出大观园的……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... if I'm being honest—and here's something I never told Wei—I felt unutterably lost. There was so much that I had to do, so much responsibility.
但说实话，我茫然得说不出话。我甚至都没有和卫说过……因为我在之后还有太多的事情要做。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I guess neither of us were that ready for the world when we left home.
结果我们两个都在没有做好准备的情况下就离开了家。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I feel just as lost back home, though.
即使回到家后，我依然很迷茫。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Ah, and there's Heathcliff, too—he also left home. Sometime ago, we paid a visit to the manor he grew up in.
啊，还有希斯克利夫先生，他也和我们一起回到过以前住过的宅邸。

Heading home must've been pretty exciting for him. You have no idea how much of the journey back he spent gussying up and primping his hair...
不知道是不是因为久违地回到家而心情激动，当时在巴士上他可是花了好久彻底打扮了一番呢……

... Somethin' just came up.
啊，我突然想起件事……

Class dismissed.
今天的课就到此为止。
